Privacy notice

What the site stores, which services receive requests, and how to control optional measurement.

Effective November 6, 2026. This notice covers Contract Compass on contract-compass-beta.vercel.app. The project’s public support channel is available for questions.

Market data and hosting

Your browser requests public contract data from Binance. Those requests include the chosen public symbol and intervals, and the providers receive ordinary network information such as an IP address. Vercel serves this website and may process request logs for operation and security. We cannot promise that infrastructure providers retain no logs.

Information kept in your browser

The workspace stores your last contract, horizon, theme, and Beginner-view preference in local storage. Optional measurement preferences use a separate local-storage entry. Calculator balances and risk inputs remain in page memory; this implementation does not send them to Binance, analytics, or advertising and does not save them.

Optional usage measurement

Usage measurement is off unless you opt in through Privacy choices. Usage measurement is not configured on this deployment. The integration only permits known public page paths, removes query strings and fragments, and does not send calculator inputs, signals, or custom events. Global Privacy Control and Do Not Track suppress this integration. Blocking measurement does not block the app.

Vercel describes how its service processes visitor information in its Web Analytics privacy documentation. Opting out here reloads the page to stop an already loaded measurement script. It cannot undo information sent before withdrawal.

Advertising

Live advertising is disabled on this deployment. The site does not load advertising or advertising-consent scripts in this state. The site’s own privacy dialog is not a certified advertising consent platform. See Google’s advertising information for its practices.

Your controls

Use Privacy choices below to enable or disable optional usage measurement. You can clear this site’s local storage through your browser to remove preferences. Leaving or closing the page ends its market monitoring. External links and GitHub support have their own privacy notices.

Changes and contact

This notice must be updated if the operator changes the services or collection described here. For questions, use the Contact page; do not include sensitive details in a public report.
